title: Sample 20-1: Pronunciation and Summary Keys (Print Only)

illustrates.quote: Summary keys are a reminder of the diacritics being used, and appear typically on each page or alternate pages in some alphabetic reference material. (See Sample 20-1: Pronunciation and Summary Keys on page 20-13, Sample 20-2: Pronunciation and Paragraph Summary on page 20-14, and Sample 20-3: Pronunciation Key on Odd Pages on page 20-15.)

print.notes: Print only: the sample is a full-page photograph or scan of dictionary/glossary pages (gold-20-A/page-551.png), not modellable as flat print blocks; no braille is given.

braille.notes: Print only; the source has no braille for this sample.
